name: atlas-video
description: The 9:58 submission video (D10/D12), programmed in Remotion and rendered locally

scripts.timeline: cd .. && python -m contexts.demo video json video/src/timeline.json
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Atlas out/atlas.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.check: cd .. && python -m contexts.demo video check video/out/atlas.mp4
